Class WindowedVsGlobalSpatialFalsificationHarness

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.WindowedVsGlobalSpatialFalsificationHarness
public class WindowedVsGlobalSpatialFalsificationHarness extends Object
Scientific Falsification invalid input: '&' Validation Harness: Windowed Sub-Grids vs. Full Planetary Sphere.

Executes multi-resolution spatial sweeps (H3 Res 1 to Res 3), temporal integration sweeps (7d, 30d, 90d, 365d), boundary mode comparisons (DYNAMIC_RESERVOIR vs. CLOSED_BARRIER vs. PERIODIC_TOROIDAL), and historical isolation case studies (Pre-Columbian Americas 1000-1491 AD and Madagascar 500-1000 AD).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.1
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
